data.summary: Repair the three independent review findings: persist the version-0 Skill baseline, apply and record member revisions for owner-verified Wish Pool discussions, and replace the experience placeholder example with NONE.
results: Baseline version 0 is stored once and restored from immutable member history.
Plan tasks and Wish Pool discussions freeze the member's latest configured Skills; completion validates the frozen member and discussion Owner before recording an update.
The model sees experience=NONE as the only example placeholder and is told not to copy placeholders.
data.residual_risk: Tests, migration execution, application startup, Worker execution, browser interaction and real model calls were not run.
